title: Rejection toast is gated on pipe selection, but the dial path (right-click) never selects — a rejected dial move is silent, contradicting the code's own intent
evidence:
draw_hud (app/main.odin:454, 493-496): "if app.sel_pipe >= 0 {" ... "// the transient QoS rejection toast (a rejected dial/lane edit is
		// never silent — e.g. E6's never-drop guard once that content exists)
		if app.last_reject != .None && app.tick - app.reject_tick < 30 { // ~1.5s at 20Hz
			draw_text(app, reject_label(app.last_reject), 12, 156, 16, rl.Color{200, 60, 60, 255})" — the toast draws ONLY when a pipe is selected. cycle_emphasis (app/main.odin:389-392): "// a rejected dial move is never silent (e.g. E6's never-drop zeroing
		// guard once never-drop content exists) — surface it in the HUD.
		app.last_reject = err
		app.reject_tick = app.tick". The right-click path (app/main.odin:199-204) calls "if pid, ok := pipe_hit(app, wx, wy); ok { cycle_emphasis(app, pid) }" WITHOUT setting app.sel_pipe — so a rejection via right-click on an unselected pipe sets last_reject and the toast never draws.
detail: The toast is inside `if app.sel_pipe >= 0`, but the rejection source (right-click dial) does not select. A rejected dial move on an unselected pipe is silent, contradicting the code comment's "never silent" promise. Latent today (no never-drop classes shipped), reachable once E6 content exists.
recommended_fix: Move the rejection-toast draw block outside the `if app.sel_pipe >= 0` gate (it already has its own time-based expiry), so a right-click rejection surfaces regardless of selection.

title: pipe_hit radius hardcoded at 10 world px while the sibling interaction radius (snap_radius) is data-driven in balance.json
evidence: pipe_hit (app/main.odin:319): "radius := f32(10) // world px — comfortably inside the fat-pipe read" vs snap_node (app/main.odin:286): "radius := f32(app.cat.balance.snap_radius)". balance.json carries "snap_radius": 36 as the established interaction-radius home (ODN-5: "All balance/content lives in data//*.json", arch §11.7 enforcement "Balance numbers | in data//, never literals").
detail: The established pattern for world-px interaction radii is balance.json (snap_radius). The new pipe hit radius is a magic literal in code, so tuning it requires an edit+recompile instead of a data change.
recommended_fix: Add a pipe_hit_radius entry to data/balance.json (with a catalog default + comment, like snap_radius) and read it via app.cat.balance in pipe_hit.
